items.desc: International touring DJs, record label, and longstanding Glaswegian party was founded by Jonnie Wilkes (JG Wilkes) & Keith McIvor (JD Twitch) in Glasgow in 1997. Optimo now exists as the solo project of JG Wilkes since the tragic and untimely passing of JD Twitch in September 2025. The Optimo (Espacio) NTS show, now in it's 10th year, exhibits a unique disregard for genres and musical restrictions, striking out into often head-messing territories - from the "sublime to the ridiculous" - oddball electronic, Post Punk rarities, 4th World, EBM, Dub, Techno, Synth Pop, and bags of new unreleased…
